# package mms

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-otfp/protocols/mms"
```

Package mms fingerprints IEC 61850 / ISO 9506 MMS over ISO-on-TCP.

A COTP connection confirm alone does not identify MMS: Siemens S7 and every other ISO-on-TCP stack confirm too. Detection therefore completes an association: COTP CR (TSEL 0x0001), then one data TPDU carrying an ISO 8327 session CONNECT, an ISO 8823 presentation CP, an ACSE AARQ for the MMS application context (1.0.9506.2.3) and an MMS Initiate-Request, as IEC 61850 clients send it. A session ACCEPT carrying an AARE and an MMS Initiate-Response proves MMS; a refusal at the ACSE or MMS level still identifies an MMS stack.

In identify mode the MMS Identify service is called (vendor, model, revision). The association is concluded before closing.
